'''Doallyn''' was a [[Hunting/Legends|hunter]] from [[Geran/Legends|Geran]] who served under [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]].

==Biography==
A [[Hunting/Legends|hunter]] by trade, Doallyn had two reasons to wear a mask: the first being that he needed to breathe [[hydron-three]] to stay alive on [[Planet/Legends|planets]] with an [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]]-rich [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]], the second being that his face was once hideously scarred by the poisoned claws of a [[Corellian sand panther/Legends|Corellian sand panther]]. He eventually came to [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] to hunt a [[Krayt dragon/Legends|krayt dragon]] for [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] to pit against his [[Jabba's rancor/Legends|rancor]] in a head-to-head fight. However, he ended up getting drunk in the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]], and [[Gambling/Legends|gambled]] to his detriment. He awoke from his drinking binge to discover that he had lost the game and now owed Jabba a [[Standard year/Legends|year's]] service.

[[File:Doallyn_SWI_60.jpg|thumb|left|235px|Doallyn]]
During one memorable time in [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]], immediately following the feeding of [[Oola/Legends|Oola]] to the [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]], an [[Ubese/Legends|Ubese]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] named [[Boushh/Legends|Boushh]], actually [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] in disguise, silenced the crowd with a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] shot. As Doallyn hurried over to inspect the situation, he found himself thrown painfully against the wall by "Boushh's" quarry, the powerful [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]]. Both Leia and Chewbacca were only posing as a bounty hunter and captive respectively to attempt to rescue their friend, [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]].<ref name="Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi">{{Film|VI}}</ref>

[[Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon|When Jabba died]], Doallyn escaped with the dancer [[Yarna d'al' Gargan/Legends|Yarna d'al' Gargan]], who knew about [[Dannik Jerriko]] killing people, and so he promised to guard her if she led him to Jabba's supply of cartridges of hydron-three that would keep him alive. Doallyn saved her from an attempted assault by [[Tornik]] and [[Warlug]]. Later, when Jerriko appeared in front of them, Doallyn shot him, which forced the [[Anzat (species)|Anzat]] to retreat into the shadows.

With the supplies, the two fled towards Mos Eisley in a [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]]. During their conversations, Doallyn confessed to Yarna about his face being hideously scarred behind his mask and how it had happened.

Later, near to Mos Eisley, their speeder crashed into a sand pit, right next to a krayt dragon. Doallyn managed to kill it with one shot directly in its [[Sinuses|sinus cavity]]. Although after he had taken the [[Krayt dragon pearl/Legends|pearls]] from its stomach, he was cutting off part of the tail as a trophy when it twitched reflexively, knocking him out. By now Doallyn had run out of hydron-three, the canisters of gas he needed to breathe to stay alive. Yarna carried him to Mos Eisley, and used some of the jewels she had been saving in order to buy back her children to buy him some more hydron-three, which saved his life. He repaid her with the dragon pearls, and together they bought back her children ([[Luka d'al' Gargan|Luka]] and [[Leia d'al' Gargan]], named after [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and Leia Organa, and [[Nautag d'al' Gargan II|Nautag d'al' Gargan]] named after the [[Nautag d'al' Gargan|cubs' father]]), bought a spaceship and left [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="Skin Deep: The Fat Dancer's Tale">{{StoryCite|story=Skin Deep: The Fat Dancer's Tale|book=Tales from Jabba's Palace}}</ref>

The two became free traders, specializing in textiles and gems. Yarna often danced to earn extra [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]&mdash;in fact she even danced at the wedding of Han Solo and Leia Organa&mdash;and Doallyn sometimes hunted creatures to sell to [[Zoo/Legends|zoos]]. Yarna's children became a [[Jizz/Legends|jizz]] swing band, and together they toured [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. When Yarna became a model for jeweled [[Clothing/Legends|brassieres]], Doallyn managed her career.<ref name="Epilogue: Whatever Became Of...?">{{StoryCite|story=Epilogue: Whatever Became Of...?|book=Tales from Jabba's Palace}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:BrockStarsherHelmet-SWCOT.png|thumb|200px|Helmet worn by both Brock Starsher and Doallyn]]
There are actually two Geranites in [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Return of the Jedi'']]. The first is seen more closely when [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] pushes him down the steps of the entrance to Jabba's Audience Chamber. This Geranite wears a black mask and black body suit identical to [[Bane Malar/Legends|Bane Malar's]]. This Geranite was identified as Doallyn in ''Tales from Jabba's Palace''<ref name="Skin Deep: The Fat Dancer's Tale" />

[[File:Sergeant_doallyn.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Image of Brock Starsher identified as Doallyn]]
The [[Brock Starsher/Legends|second Geranite]] appears aboard the second skiff at the [[Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon]]. He wears a black helmet and a white body suit. The [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]] identified this white suited Geranite as Doallyn. This Geranite is killed by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], yet Doallyn is supposed to have survived the battle of Carkoon and returned to [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]] to rescue [[Yarna d'al' Gargan/Legends|Yarna d'al' Gargan]]. There were probably two actors wearing similar outfits and the same helmet during filming. It is assumed that the black-outfit Doallyn in Jabba's Palace is the actual Doallyn, while the white-outfit skiff guard is a completely different character that has been identified as [[Brock Starsher/Legends|Brock Starsher]].
